title: Knight Science Journalism Academic-Year Fellowship
about: Knight Science Journalism @MIT accepts applications for its 2027-28 Academic-Year Fellowship class, based in the Boston/Cambridge area, United States, from mid-August 2027 to May 2028. Applications opened 15 November 2026 and close 9 January 2027, 11:59 pm Eastern Time.
requirements: Applicants cannot have completed a residential fellowship of four months or longer in the two years before applying
Fellows must live in the Boston/Cambridge area during the 2027-28 academic year
